paragraphs.text: Pari's Golden Beach was a beach on an unnamed island that was so named by the golden jetsam littering its sands.

The sand itself was not gold but instead was littered with gold: coins, jewelry, drinking cups, ceremonial masks, armor, and even statues. The air above the gold rippled with heat, and this heat attracted sea dragons , savoring the island of warmth in the otherwise cold waters of northern Terisiare .

The beach was first discovered by Pari , a man who reclaimed the Isles of Argive from raiders after the Sylex Blast . A few generations later, during the Dark Age , Agrippa the Wayfinder, Pari's great-grandson, shipwrecked on the island and discovered the beach. He bided his time, spending over a month on the island, before managing to steal off with some of the gold and reach passage with a ship.
